wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# StreamClip - Android Video Processing Application

## Project Introduction

StreamClip is a powerful Android video processing application built on FFmpeg technology, designed to provide professional-grade video editing capabilities directly on mobile devices. The application focuses on lossless video operations while maintaining high-quality output and offering real-time processing feedback.

### Purpose Statement
StreamClip serves as a comprehensive video processing toolkit that enables users to perform various video editing operations including trimming, merging, extracting audio, compressing, and metadata manipulation without compromising video quality.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Lossless Operations**: Implement stream-copying techniques to preserve original video quality
- **Real-time Feedback**: Provide instant progress updates and performance metrics
- **Hardware Acceleration**: Leverage Android's MediaCodec for optimal processing speed
- **User-Friendly Interface**: Offer intuitive Material Design 3 interface with customizable tab layouts
- **Batch Processing**: Support queue-based processing for multiple video operations

### Target Audience
- Content creators requiring mobile video editing solutions
- Social media enthusiasts needing quick video processing
- Professional videographers working on-the-go
- Users seeking high-quality video compression without quality loss

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modular architecture with clear separation between UI components, business logic, and native FFmpeg integration.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[MainActivity] --> B[MainPagerAdapter]
    B --> C[Fragment Components]
    C --> D[FFmpegService]
    D --> E[FFmpegKit Library]
    A --> F[BatchTaskService]
    F --> G[TaskQueueManager]
    G --> H[BatchNotificationManager]
    A --> I[SettingsManager]
    A --> J[FileUtils]
    A --> K[LocaleHelper]
```

### Component Breakdown

**UI Layer**: Built with Material Design 3 components using ViewPager2 and TabLayout for tab-based navigation. The main activity manages tab ordering and provides global functionality like settings, logging, and help dialogs.

**Service Layer**: Implements background processing through dedicated services for batch operations and FFmpeg command execution. The architecture supports both foreground and background processing modes.

**Data Layer**: Utilizes SharedPreferences for configuration management and maintains task queues with persistent state tracking.

**Native Integration**: Direct integration with FFmpegKit library for advanced video processing capabilities, including hardware acceleration support.

### Design Patterns

The application implements several key design patterns:

- **Repository Pattern**: Centralized data access through FFmpegService and TaskQueueManager
- **Observer Pattern**: State management using Kotlin Flow for task progress updates
- **Factory Pattern**: Fragment instantiation through MainPagerAdapter
- **Singleton Pattern**: Global configuration management via SettingsManager and TaskQueueManager

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant MainActivity
    participant CompressFragment
    participant FFmpegService
    participant BatchTaskService
    
    User->>MainActivity: Select video operation
    MainActivity->>CompressFragment: Load fragment
    CompressFragment->>FFmpegService: Execute command
    FFmpegService->>FFmpegService: Process with FFmpegKit
    FFmpegService-->>CompressFragment: Progress updates
    CompressFragment-->>User: Display results
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **MainActivity** (`app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/MainActivity.kt`): Primary application entry point managing tab navigation and global functionality
- **BaseActivity** (`app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/BaseActivity.kt`): Base activity class handling internationalization and locale management

### Core Modules
- **FFmpegService** (`app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/service/FFmpegService.kt`): Centralized video processing service handling all FFmpeg operations including trimming, merging, compression, and audio extraction
- **BatchTaskService** (`app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/service/BatchTaskService.kt`): Background service managing batch processing queues and task execution
- **TaskQueueManager** (`app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/service/TaskQueueManager.kt`): State management for batch processing tasks with real-time progress tracking

### Configuration Approach
- **SettingsManager** (`app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/util/SettingsManager.kt`): Handles application preferences including output directory configuration, screen wake-up settings, and cache management
- **Build Configuration** (`app/build.gradle.kts`): Multi-flavor build system supporting different distribution channels (full, github, store)

### External Dependencies
- **FFmpegKit 8.1**: Core video processing library integrated as AAR dependency
- **Material Design Components**: Modern UI components for consistent user experience
- **Kotlin Coroutines**: Asynchronous programming for non-blocking operations
- **AndroidX Libraries**: Modern Android development components

### Integration Points
- **Android Permissions**: Comprehensive permission handling for storage access across Android versions
- **File Provider**: Secure file sharing through Android's FileProvider mechanism
- **Foreground Services**: Background processing with notification support

### Component Relationships

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class MainActivity {
        +setupViewPager()
        +checkPermissions()
        +showAboutDialog()
    }
    
    class MainPagerAdapter {
        +createFragment()
        +getItemCount()
    }
    
    class FFmpegService {
        +executeCommand()
        +trimVideo()
        +mergeVideos()
        +compressVideo()
    }
    
    class BatchTaskService {
        +processQueue()
        +executeTask()
        +handleStart()
    }
    
    class TaskQueueManager {
        +enqueueAll()
        +next()
        +updateProgress()
    }
    
    MainActivity --> MainPagerAdapter
    MainPagerAdapter --> FFmpegService
    BatchTaskService --> TaskQueueManager
    BatchTaskService --> FFmpegService
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Video Processing Operations**:
- **Trimming**: Lossless video cutting using stream copying with precise time selection
- **Merging**: Concatenation of multiple video files without re-encoding
- **Audio Extraction**: Direct audio stream extraction preserving original quality
- **Compression**: Hardware-accelerated H.264/H.265 encoding with customizable quality settings
- **Custom Commands**: Advanced users can execute custom FFmpeg commands with real-time logging

**Advanced Features**:
- **Batch Processing**: Queue multiple operations for sequential execution
- **Real-time Progress**: Percentage completion, elapsed time, and estimated remaining time
- **Metadata Preservation**: Complete retention of GPS coordinates, timestamps, and device information
- **Hardware Acceleration**: Automatic MediaCodec utilization for optimal performance
- **Internationalization**: Support for Simplified Chinese and English languages

### Implementation Highlights

**Performance Optimization**:
- Hardware-accelerated encoding using MediaCodec for H.264/H.265
- Lossless operations through stream copying to preserve quality
- Efficient memory management with proper resource cleanup
- Background processing with proper lifecycle management

**User Experience**:
- Intuitive tab-based interface with customizable tab ordering
- Real-time progress feedback with detailed metrics
- Comprehensive error handling with user-friendly messages
- Persistent settings and configuration management

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Processing: Start Operation
    Processing --> Success: Complete Successfully
    Processing --> Error: Processing Failed
    Processing --> Cancelled: User Cancelled
    Success --> Idle: Reset State
    Error --> Idle: Reset State
    Cancelled --> Idle: Reset State
    
    state Processing {
        [*] --> Probing
        Probing --> Executing
        Executing --> Updating
        Updating --> [*]
    }
```

The application demonstrates a well-architected Android application that successfully balances performance, user experience, and technical complexity. Its modular design allows for easy maintenance and future feature additions while maintaining high standards for video processing quality and user interaction.

**Sources:**
- [MainActivity.kt](app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/MainActivity.kt)
- [MainPagerAdapter.kt](app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/adapter/MainPagerAdapter.kt)
- [FFmpegService.kt](app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/service/FFmpegService.kt)
- [BatchTaskService.kt](app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/service/BatchTaskService.kt)
- [SettingsManager.kt](app/src/main/java/com/pisces312/streamclip/util/SettingsManager.kt)
- [build.gradle.kts](app/build.gradle.kts)
- [AndroidManifest.xml](app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml)

</blog>
